reported.title: Injector pulse is 2000 ms instead of 800 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 2000 on line 7, and the pulse-end check on line 79 uses that constant, so every pulse runs 2000 ms. Measured evidence confirms this: "pulse from 1.03 s lasted 2000 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms" and "pulse from 1.02 s lasted 2001 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms". The constant must be 800 to satisfy the spec. 2 of 2 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 1.03 s lasted 2000 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms. A trigger at 2.51 s came during this pulse, which must not change its length.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D4 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); mist injector on D9; ready lamp on D12.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts an 800 ms HIGH pulse on D9 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D12 HIGH when idle and LOW while the injector pulse is active.
- Print `mist shots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 450 ms.
